title: Clorox® Pool&Spa™ Swimming Pool Algaecide and Clarifier, Prevents and Treats Pool Algae, Clears Water, 128 Fl Oz (Pack of 1)
features: Pool Algae Treatment: Our Pool Algaecide and Clarifier is specially formulated to treat existing algae while providing long-lasting defense against stubborn growth, ensuring that your pool remains clear and algae-free for an extended period of time.
Maintain Crystal Clear Water: Kills and prevents all types of swimming pool algae (green, mustard, black algae) for crystal clear swimming pool water.
Non-Foaming Formula: Spend less time maintaining and more time enjoying your pool with this Swimming Pool Algaecide and Clarifier, which features a non-foaming formula.

Suitable for Use in All Types of Pools: This product is proven to meet the needs of every pool owner, as it is compatible with all types of pools, including saltwater pools. You can trust our product to deliver exceptional performance and keep your pool water clean and clear.
For best results, add to the deepest end of the pool with the filter running. Circulating pool water when applying chemicals helps disperse chemicals throughout the pool for maximum coverage
Clorox Pool App: Test like an expert anytime, anywhere with the Clorox Pool App. Solve common swimming pool problems and get personalized product and dosage recommendations.
